items.reason: Identifies the same incorrect && permission check and proposes ||. Its claim that owners also fail is inaccurate, but fixing the described condition fixes the golden issue.
Explicitly describes the same case-variation bypass of BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS. The broader comment also includes the intra-request duplication problem in #03.

Describes using the caller's calendar credentials instead of the booking organizer's when constructing EventManager.
